The '''supreme commander of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force''' was the title given to the leader of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]]. During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], the title was held by the [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]]. In this capacity, he oversaw all of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] military campaigns.<ref name="Codex" />
